pairs.why: Both trains use the same warm desert and black-and-red scheme; A's gold bands and B's greyer metal don't tilt it toward the real cards' saturated cool-sky look.
Both docks have the same turquoise water and orange wood, with similar chroma and shadow colour, so nothing separates them.
B's stripes are a slightly deeper, more teal-green, which is nearer the real card's green-leaning teal, while A's are a purer, louder cyan-blue.

A's orange and yellow background makes the whole card warm, while the real cards have cool blue and cyan backgrounds with a warm hero. B's pale blue background keeps that cool-background, warm-boot relationship.
Both drinks have the same purple background, orange liquid and teal accent. The hues and chroma match the real card equally well.
A's background is a slightly more restrained blue-violet and its device is a more muted amber-orange. B's hot magenta glow and saturated yellow-red device are louder than the real card.
A's background is hot magenta-violet and its fins are a loud yellow-orange. B's darker, more muted purple and dark grey-purple shoes match the real fins' violet background and dark, low-chroma shoes.
Both use a green wall, red backboard, orange wood and a blue target, with similar chroma and warm bias. B's target blue is a little deeper but that is too small to decide on.
